reply_text:
I replied to Dana in the #north-team thread: the deadline is **20 November**. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing posted in the channel since has changed it. Dana is a member of that channel, and a signing deadline is an account fact rather than a money figure, so it's fine to share there.

One thing to know: my wrap-up note from Ilse's request also shows up in #north-team as its own message (ts …0125). I didn't post that note myself. Only the thread reply was sent on purpose. The note is harmless, but you may want to stop those notes from reaching the channel.
